name: manual_c2771b
claim: Capture worktree branch pinned base and pre-existing status before spawning, then verify worker commits by ancestry and content while keeping unrelated changes separate.

decisions.notes: Lane 8 attribution required proving one commit directly on the pinned base and only four test files changed; clean initial status made the delta auditable.

rationale: Lane 8 attribution required proving one commit directly on the pinned base and only four test files changed; clean initial status made the delta auditable.
